custom-domain.title: Connect your own domain to your store
custom-domain.lead: Put your store on an address with your brand's name, like glowskin.com, in a few steps.
what: Every Tallaby store starts on a free address like glow.tallaby.com. When you're ready, you can connect a domain you own, so customers reach your store at an address with your brand's name.

You do this in the dashboard under Website › Domain & SEO: enter the domain, add the records shown to the DNS settings where you bought it, and follow its status on the same page. For now it's available on your main store, with one domain per account.

benefits.title: More customer trust
benefits.body: An address with your brand's name looks more professional in ads and messages.

benefits.title: One link for every campaign
benefits.body: Use the same domain in your posts, ads and WhatsApp messages.

benefits.title: Your name in search results
benefits.body: Your store shows up on Google under your own domain and brand.

steps.title: Buy a domain, or use yours
steps.body: Buy one from any domain registrar, such as GoDaddy or Namecheap, or use a domain you already own.

steps.title: Add it in the dashboard
steps.body: Open Website › Domain & SEO, enter the domain and press Connect domain. We connect the domain and its www version together.

steps.title: Add the DNS records
steps.body: Copy the records shown and add them to your domain's DNS settings. Remove any other A or CNAME records for @ and www.

steps.title: Wait for the check
steps.body: It usually takes a few minutes and can take up to 48 hours. We check automatically every day, and you can press Check now at any time.

faq.q: Is connecting a custom domain free?
faq.a: Yes. Connecting is free on both Free and Pro. You buy the domain from a registrar, at their price.

faq.q: Where do I buy a domain?
faq.a: From any domain registrar, such as GoDaddy or Namecheap. After you buy it, you'll open its DNS settings there to add the records.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Usually a few minutes. DNS changes can take up to 48 hours, depending on your provider. We check automatically every day, and you can press Check now.

faq.q: Does my store get a security certificate?
faq.a: Yes. Your store runs on your domain with a free security certificate once it's connected.

faq.q: Does my tallaby.com address keep working?
faq.a: Yes, and it forwards visitors to your domain. If you disconnect the domain, your store goes back to its Tallaby address.

faq.q: Can I connect more than one domain?
faq.a: No. For now you can connect one domain per account, on your main store only.

faq.q: I use Cloudflare. What should I do?
faq.a: Set the records to DNS only (the grey cloud), or the security certificate can't be issued.

ai-online-store.title: AI that writes your products in two languages
ai-online-store.lead: Take a photo of your product or describe it in a line, and Tallaby's AI writes the name, description and search fields in Arabic and English. You review, then publish.
ai-online-store.whatTitle: How does AI help you build your online store?
what: With Tallaby, AI takes on the hardest part of building an online store: writing the product pages. Upload up to 4 photos or a PDF, or type a few words about the product, and AI writes its name, description and search keywords in Arabic and English at once.
AI never sets the price, stock or SKU; you type those. Everything it writes shows up in the product form for you to edit before you save.

Got a lot of products? Upload an Excel, CSV or PDF file and it writes their copy in one go. You can also connect your store to Claude or ChatGPT to add and edit products from a chat. The store's design starts from a ready-made template that you pick and edit by drag and drop.

benefits.title: Arabic and English together
benefits.body: Every product is written in both languages at once, so customers read your store in the language they prefer.

benefits.title: Ready for search engines
benefits.body: A search title, description and keywords with every product, without writing them yourself.

benefits.title: You decide
benefits.body: Price and stock come from you, and you review and edit every line before it goes live.

faq.q: Does AI build my whole store?
faq.a: Today AI writes your products: the name, description and search fields in both languages. You start the store's design from a ready-made template and edit it by drag and drop.

faq.q: How often can I use AI?
faq.a: Each plan has monthly credits, and Pro has more. You can buy extra credits in your dashboard, where you see their cost before you buy.

faq.q: Does AI set the product's price?
faq.a: No. You always type the price, stock and SKU; AI writes only the copy.

faq.q: Which language does it write in?
faq.a: It writes every product in Arabic and English, even if you describe it in one language.

faq.q: Can I add many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Upload an Excel, CSV or PDF file on the add products page, AI writes their copy, and you review it before publishing.

faq.q: Can I manage my products from Claude or ChatGPT?
faq.a: Yes. Connect your store from your dashboard, then ask the assistant to add, edit or search your products. Orders and settings stay in your dashboard.

fake-order-protection.title: More real orders, fewer returns
fake-order-protection.lead: Block problem numbers, spot a risky order before you ship it, and confirm cash on delivery orders on WhatsApp in one tap.
fake-order-protection.whatTitle: What are fake orders, and how does Tallaby help?
what: Fake orders are cash on delivery orders the customer refuses at the door or never answers the rider about, so you pay shipping both ways and sell nothing. Tallaby gives you tools in your dashboard to cut these orders before you ship them.

Each order shows a badge when the customer's number refused earlier orders in your store, or when the same number ordered again within minutes. You can block a number so it can't order from your store again, and send a ready confirmation message on WhatsApp before you ship.
The platform also limits repeat orders from the same number, account or internet connection within a short time, automatically.

uses.body: Block a number from the order or the customer's page, and checkout refuses their next order.

uses.title: A risk badge on each order

uses.title: WhatsApp confirmation

uses.title: A limit on repeat orders
uses.body: A small number of orders per number, account and internet connection in a short time, automatically.

steps.title: Watch for the risk badge
steps.body: It shows when the number has refused orders in your store, or ordered twice within minutes.

steps.title: Send the confirmation message
steps.body: Press "Ask to confirm" to open WhatsApp with a ready message you can edit for each store.

steps.title: Mark it confirmed, then ship

faq.q: How can I tell an order is fake?
faq.a: There's no sure way, but the badges help: a number that refused earlier orders in your store, or a repeat order from the same number within minutes. Confirm those orders before you ship.

faq.q: Can I block a phone number?
faq.a: Yes. Add the number to your blocklist and any new order from it is refused in your store. It matches however the customer types it, such as 010 or +2010.

faq.q: Does Tallaby send the confirmation message automatically?
faq.a: No. You press "Ask to confirm" and WhatsApp opens on your phone with the message ready; you send it.

faq.q: Does a blocked customer see that they're blocked?
faq.a: They see a general message that the order didn't go through, with no mention of the block.

faq.q: Is protection on the Free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Every protection tool is on both plans at no extra cost.

faq.q: Can I ask customers for a verification code?
faq.a: Not yet. SMS verification isn't available today; what you have is blocking, the risk badge, WhatsApp confirmation and the repeat-order limit.

abandoned-checkouts.title: Don't lose a customer who started an order
abandoned-checkouts.lead: When a customer adds their address at checkout and leaves, they show up under Not completed with their number and items, so you can reach them.
what: An abandoned checkout is an order the customer started and didn't finish: they added products and typed their address, then closed the page. It happens a lot with cash on delivery, and many of those customers order if you reach them quickly.

On Tallaby, an unfinished order is saved when the customer picks or adds a shipping address at checkout, and shows in Orders › Not completed with the name, phone, items and total with shipping. When the customer places the order, it leaves the list by itself.

From each row you message them on WhatsApp with a ready message or call them, then mark the row as contacted. If the customer has an account on your store, they also get a reminder email under your store's name.

faq.q: When does an order show as not completed?
faq.a: When the customer picks or adds a shipping address at checkout, then leaves without ordering. Customers who only added items, with no address, show under Pending carts.

faq.q: Does Tallaby send WhatsApp messages automatically?
faq.a: No. You press WhatsApp, it opens on your phone with a ready message, and you send it. Automatic messages aren't available today.

faq.q: Does the customer get a reminder email?
faq.a: Yes, if they have an account on your store: they get a cart reminder under your store's name, and the row shows it was sent.

faq.q: How long do unfinished checkouts stay?
faq.a: 30 days, then they're removed automatically. Anyone who places the order leaves the list right away.

faq.q: Does the customer know I may contact them?
faq.a: Yes. Checkout shows a short line saying the store may get in touch about the order.

faq.q: Is it on the Free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Unfinished checkouts are on both plans at no extra cost.

shipping.title: Ship to every governorate, your way
shipping.lead: Set a shipping price for each governorate or area, then ship with Bosta from your dashboard, with your own riders, or with a Wassalha sheet for Egypt Post.
shipping.whatTitle: How does shipping work for online stores in Egypt?
what: Shipping orders in Egypt comes down to two questions: what the customer pays for shipping, and who delivers. On Tallaby you answer the first with shipping zones: a price for each governorate, area or district, free shipping over an amount you choose, and an optional surcharge by weight.

You answer the second your way: connect your Bosta account and send orders from your dashboard, add your own riders and assign orders to them, or download a ready sheet and upload it to your Wassalha account for Egypt Post.
Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself and doesn't set carrier prices. Your Bosta price is your own account's price.

faq.q: Does Tallaby deliver orders?
faq.a: No. Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself. You ship with your own Bosta account, your riders, or a Wassalha sheet for Egypt Post.

faq.q: Which shipping companies can I use?
faq.a: Bosta connects directly from your dashboard. Wassalha for Egypt Post works through a sheet you download and upload yourself. Others, such as Aramex, J&T and Mylerz, aren't connected yet.

faq.q: What does shipping with Bosta cost?
faq.a: Bosta sets the price for your account with them. Tallaby adds nothing to the shipping price.

faq.q: Can I set a different price for each governorate?
faq.a: Yes. Create a zone for a governorate, a group of governorates or even a single district, each with its own price and delivery time.

faq.q: Can I offer free shipping?
faq.a: Yes. Set an amount above which shipping is free, for each zone.

faq.q: Can I turn off cash on delivery for a far zone?
faq.a: Yes. Each shipping zone has its own cash on delivery switch.

shipping.closingTitle: Set up shipping for your store in minutes

featuresHub.explainerTitle: Which features does your online store need?
featuresHub.explainer: An online store in Egypt needs more than product pages: cash on delivery with protection from refused orders, shipping for each governorate, follow-up for people who didn't finish ordering, and clear product copy in both languages. Every one of these features is on both plans, and each page here explains what the feature does today, with no promises about what isn't built yet. Shipping, payment and tracking integrations have their own page.
